chapter.title: OF OFFENCES RELATING TO DOCUMENTSAND TO[2]*** PROPERTY MARKS

heading: Using as genuine, forged or counterfeit currency-notes or bank-notes.
text: Whoever sells to, or buys or receives from, any other person, or otherwise traffics in or uses as genuine, any forged or counterfeit currency-note or bank-note, knowing or having reason to believe the same to be forged or counterfeit, shall be punished with [4][imprisonment for life], or with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Subs. by Act 26 of 1955, s. 117 and the Sch., for “transportation for life” (w.e.f. 1-1-1956).
